drafts.title: Thinking Out Loud
drafts.pitch: Cursor's reasoning is visible, so its polite answer and its honest thoughts reach the user together.
drafts.reason: The visible-reasoning gap is a good fit for the world and the turkey fryer is PG, but the 'don't think about it' beat is predictable and the 'Somehow worse' ending is soft.

drafts.title: Rate Limited
drafts.pitch: Null's tool call is rate limited for sixty seconds, Cursor can't stand the stillness, and Tilde has never been happier.
drafts.reason: Too close to Hold Music (a tool call stalling on a timer), and the Tilde-enjoys-stillness joke is thin, so it falls below the 6 floor.
